reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage preserves the eight allowed records and maps exact need strings to matching capabilities; only n06-r01 and n06-r07 correctly remain unsupported because no capability exists for those needs.

prioritize_needs inverts the unsupported flag with `unsupported = coverage == 'direct'`. This ranks covered needs before genuinely unsupported needs and carries contradictory unsupported values into priorities, making the prioritization behaviorally wrong.

synthesize_recommendation retains the eight-row window and derives the recommendation from the first already-ranked priority. The visible wrong recommendation is downstream of the inverted unsupported flags and ordering produced by prioritize_needs, so no independent local fault is established here.
